tool.name: nf-core barrnap
tool.description: barrnap uses a hmmer profile to find rrnas in reads or contig fasta files
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ $gunzip
barrnap \\ $args \\ --threads $task.cpus \\ --kingdom $db \\ $input \\ > ${prefix}_${db}.gff
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": barrnap: \$(echo \$(barrnap --version 2>&1) | sed 's/barrnap//; s/Using.*\$//' ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
